advertisements.orientationNotice: The customer display picks ads by layout: idle full screen plays Landscape and Any ads; the right panel during checkout plays Portrait and Any ads. If a slot has no matching ad, it falls back to all enabled ads.

orientationHelp.landscape: Plays full screen when idle; recommended 1366×768 (16:9)
orientationHelp.portrait: Plays in the right panel during checkout; recommended 772×870 (about 0.89:1)
orientationHelp.any: Plays in both slots; slots with a different ratio show borders
